verdict.rationale: Browserbase is a browser-session API, so automatic cost-aware configuration selection is a fair axis for it. However, no evidence shows the API picks the cheapest configuration that still succeeds. The Optimize tool turns completed Agent runs into reusable scripts or better system prompts. That is an adjacent optimization feature, not automatic cost-based configuration selection.

support.subject: As a developer, I can let the API automatically pick the cheapest configuration that still succeeds
